title.narrative: Office setup, Number of Training and trained, technical support, Awards, Website, Business visits

description.narrative: EUDarkhan Innovation & Entrepreneurship Hub (EUDIEH) set up, 10 training programs for potential 100 social and tech entrepreneurs (general and specialized), training modules, mentorships, online webinars, 3 EU case study visits, 10 entrepreneurs provided seed capital and technical support, 1 EUDIEH Award for best Entrepreneurs, 1 Website and Marketing platform, 2 Business visits to the EU for 10 selected entrepreneurs

comment.narrative: 1. EUDarkhan Innovation and Entrepreneurship Hub office was set up and purchased office supplies including computers printers projector software licenses and stationaries according to the procurement guideline and the budget allocated in this regard for constant effective project management and operation. 2. 10 training modules are in the progress of development and especially identification of the needs analysis for SMEs. 3. Related to the FRIENDSHIP project website and marketing platform TOR Terms of Reference was created and the TOR proposal call was announced last week on the local official media. We will include more detailed information in the next report.

title.narrative: Network Building

description.narrative: one InterRegional DarkhanEU Forum (IDEF) set up, 1 Rapid Assessment Report on Joint Areas of Cooperation, IDEF Network Meetings, 1.4 12 IDEF Best Practice forums, Study Visits & Exchange Programmes /4 Study Visits, 2 Exchange Programmes/

title.narrative: Number of meetings, forums and exchange visits

description.narrative: Number of meetingsNumber of forumsNumber of exchange visits

comment.narrative: 1. Project launching event and forumThe launching event marked the official start of the Friendship project to strengthen EUMongolia Friendship through equitable resilient and innovative growth in Darkhan UulProvince on March 9th at the Buudai hotel in Darkhan Mongolia. It was also an opportunity for the stakeholder representatives potential institutions and their delegates to gather to network and seek a fuller understanding of what the project will achieve and how it will impact their DarkhanUul province. 2. The President of Mongolia announced that one billion trees will be planted around Mongolia by 2030 to combat environmental degradation desertification and dust storm at the 76th session of the UN General Assembly. Within the frame of this national movement it is necessary to improve the legal environment provide proper policy planning integrated management and organization train professional personnel and labor force establish seedlings fertilizers greenhouses and forestry introduce new techniques and technologies and provide water supply. And DarkhanUul province shall plant 20 million trees in 11 years. In this regard the Green Darkhan 2032 program was approved by Resolution No. 07 of the Citizens Representatives Khural on October 17 2021. The Green Darkhan 2032 forest forum was initiated by the Governor of DarkhanUul province and coorganized by the FRIENDSHIP project. The forum aimed to improve residents living conditions through afforestation rehabilitation expansion of forest strips and green areas. FRIENDSHIP project saw this forum as one of the preIDEF building activities and coorganized along with the Environmental and Tourism Department of DarkhanUul province. The guidance note generated based on the Green Darkhan 2032 forum open discussion included the following parts regarding the FRIENDSHIP project implementation. Relocate the new technology and best practice in the frame of implementation of the European Union Forest Strategy 2030 and Biodiversity Strategy 2030 programsStudy the experience of the experts in the European Union in the frame of implementation of the Billion Trees national movement and the Green Darkhan2032 programDeliver the short competency training based on SABMULS.3. DarkhanEducation expo2022 This expo is organized in DarkhanUul first time and It aims to promote local higher and vocational training institutes. The target group of this expo is high school graduates or youth in Darkhan. FRIENDSHIP project sees that this is a very good chance to advocate our project activity to youth. So in this regard FRIENDSHIP project team participating in the organizing team together with local Government Agency as the Family Child and Youth development Agency Labour and welfare service center and more. Other activities in progress1. IDEF InterRegional Darkhan EU Forum set up related works are in operation and specially IDEF concept note is created and is in the progress of further development. 2. RARJAC Rapid assessment Report on Joint Areas of Cooperation report is in the development process. Analysis was done comparing all national policy documents national programs and DarkhanUul provinces subprograms with the FRIENDSHIP project activities.3. A study visit and best practice forums are planned to organize in Mongolia at the end of June or beginning of July. Study visits and best practice forum related preparation works are recently started.
